coaching_implication: Coach rep to answer legitimacy challenges with specificity (per protocols.how_did_you_get_my_number) instead of moving past them into the pitch.

quote: My credit, I don't have no good credit to get financed solar. You gotta leave me alone.
stewart_read: This is exactly the objection_inversion trigger pattern — a stated financial hardship that could be reframed as the reason solar helps (eliminating the electric bill) rather than a disqualifier. The rep instead moves toward the hard credit qualifier.
alternative_hypothesis: Reactive read: the rep may have correctly recognized this as a genuine hard-DQ signal (sub-670 credit) rather than a workable objection, since Ion's credit qualifier is a hard_dq per qualifiers.credit_qualifier.
coaching_implication: Discuss with rep whether an inversion attempt (bill pain framing) was worth trying before running the qualifier, since the customer's language was ambiguous between 'objection' and 'flat disqualifier.'

stewart_read: Customer has just disclosed financial stress twice and asked to be left alone; the rep's response is a filler acknowledgment with no empathetic content before continuing the pitch.
coaching_implication: Model a one-line acknowledgment of the customer's stated situation before continuing, rather than a bare 'gotcha' filler.

quote: Yeah. I mean, the only free part, Mustafa, is we take care of the installation fee and no down payment, no upfront cost.
stewart_read: Rep explains financing mechanics (installation fee waiver, no down payment, bill elimination) in detail — this is closer-tier financial content being delivered by the setter to a customer who has already said he can't afford it.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic read: rep may be trying to overcome the cost objection with the 'no upfront cost' framing before running credit — but this didn't land given the customer's immediate pushback questioning whether it's really free.
coaching_implication: Coach rep to use the universal escape hatch ('the specialist will walk through the exact numbers') rather than detailing the financial structure themselves, especially to a clearly resistant customer.
